meta.title: Count is of PRs, not items
gaps: The exact PR-1 and PR-8 numbers cannot be asserted as dynamic values by the catalog; the plan verifies the notification's PR label and distinct-PR count instead.

args.goal: As User A, assign the 3 items from PR-1 and the 1 item from PR-8 together, then click the top-right bell to open notifications; stop with the assignment notification visible.

steps.note: No catalog domain step can assign multiple PR items to a user or open the assignment notification flow, so perform those buyer-side actions in the current session.

Verify the notification counts one additional PR, indicating 2 PRs rather than counting the four items as three additional items.
